svg.text: DT5-M01 · Carrier and torque reaction assembly
Exploded display offsets; nominal custom parts, purchased motor and coupling references.
All bolt / weld / plate ratings held
Motor plate: Ø200 pilot; 8×Ø17.5 on Ø265 PCD
Backplate: Ø232 opening; holes X±145, Z380/460/540/620
Carrier plate spans Y925–945; motor mounts on Y945
6 mm welds are a proposal, not a rated connection.
Guide wear pads and trunnion covers need final fits and retention.
DT5 R1 · 20 October 2026 · mm · Development geometry; supplier and structural approval required before fabrication.
